description: Second argument of `form()`. Receives a path tree (`path.email`) on which you declare rules once; they stay reactive.
`required`, `email`, `min`, `max`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `pattern`, each with an optional `{ message }` or `{ when }`.
Custom rule: `validate(path.x, (ctx) => ValidationResult)`. Return `undefined`/`null` when valid or `{ kind, message }` errors.
`submit(form, action)` marks fields touched, runs the async action only when valid, tracks `submitting()` and applies returned server errors.
Errors returned by the action with `fieldTree: f.email` are attached to that field until its value changes.
